title: Coordinate bound in a maximum norm ball
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set and let $c,m:I\to\mathbb R$. If $m$ lies in the open metric ball of radius $\varepsilon$ about $c$ for the supremum norm, then $|m(i)|\le \|c\|+\varepsilon$ for every $i\in I$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ lies in the open ball centered at $c$ with radius $\varepsilon$
replaced: Let $I$ be finite and $c,m\in\mathbb R^I$. If $\|m-c\|_\infty<\varepsilon$ for a real $\varepsilon$, then $|m_i|\le\|c\|_\infty+\varepsilon$ for every $i\in I$.
